## `` com.cra.figaro.algorithm.structured.strategy.range.RangingStrategy.default ``

[Full Scaladoc entry](../../target/out/jvm/scala-3.9.0/figaro/api/com/cra/figaro/algorithm/structured/strategy/range/RangingStrategy$.html#default-7bb)

```scala
def default(numValues: Int): RangingStrategy
```

Default ranging strategy. Uses finite ranging for finite atomics, and sampling for all other atomics. This avoids ranging with *, which is only allowed for lazy inference.

Type parameters: none.

Parameters, list 1: `` numValues: Int ``.

Returns: `` RangingStrategy ``.

Source contract/attributes: Default ranging strategy. Uses finite ranging for finite atomics, and sampling for all other atomics. This avoids ranging with *, which is only allowed for lazy inference. Value parameters numValues Number of values to count (for infinite integer-valued atomics) or sample (for sampled atomics) at each iteration. Attributes

Invocation template:

```scala
com.cra.figaro.algorithm.structured.strategy.range.RangingStrategy.default(numValues)
```
